name: Polymer Structure & Synthesis
summary: Introduces how polymer chains are made and how their chemistry, size and architecture determine whether a plastic is soft, tough, clear or crystalline.

topics.name: Hydrocarbon molecules, monomers and repeat units
Chain-growth (addition) polymerisation: radical, ionic and coordination (Ziegler-Natta, metallocene)
Step-growth (condensation) polymerisation: polyesters, polyamides and Carothers equation
Molecular weight: number and weight averages, distribution and measurement (GPC)
Molecular shape and configuration: tacticity, isomerism and conformations
Architecture: linear, branched, cross-linked and network polymers
Copolymers: random, alternating, block and graft
Chain statistics: random walk, end-to-end distance and radius of gyration
Polymer crystallinity: lamellae, spherulites and degree of crystallinity
Commodity and engineering polymers: PE, PP, PVC, PS, PET, PA, PC, PEEK, PTFE
Additives: plasticisers, fillers, stabilisers and flame retardants
